(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define movable
      (sort (filter (lambda (o) (or (= (obj-color o) 2) (= (obj-color o) 3) (= (obj-color o) 4))) (objects g 0))
            (lambda (a b)
              (if (= (obj-c2 a) (obj-c2 b))
                  (> (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
                  (> (obj-c2 a) (obj-c2 b))))))
    (define cleared (foldl (lambda (obj acc) (erase-cells acc (obj-cells obj) 0)) g movable))
    (define occupied
      (for/set ([cell (in-list (grid-cells cleared))] #:when (= (third cell) 5))
        (cons (first cell) (second cell))))
    (define (blocked? cells occ)
      (any? (lambda (p)
              (or (not (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) (rows g) (cols g)))
                  (set-member? occ (cons (first p) (second p)))))
            cells))
    (define (shift cells) (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (+ (second p) 1))) cells))
    (define (slide-cells cells occ)
      (let loop ([cur cells])
        (let ((nxt (shift cur)))
          (if (blocked? nxt occ) cur (loop nxt)))))
    (let-values ([(out final-occ)
                  (for/fold ([out cleared] [occ occupied]) ([obj (in-list movable)])
                    (let* ((landed (slide-cells (obj-cells obj) occ))
                           (new-out (paint-cells out landed (obj-color obj)))
                           (new-occ (for/fold ([o occ]) ([p (in-list landed)])
                                      (set-add o (cons (first p) (second p))))))
                      (values new-out new-occ)))])
      out)))
